field_text_formatted.value: Cache headers weren't being set (#3202583, patch by yahyaalhamad). View cache tags weren't reaching the JSON:API response's headers, so a page cache in front of the site never invalidated when the underlying content changed. Fixed by pushing the tags onto the response's bubbleable metadata.
